visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short dark hair wearing a black sweater stands in a modern room with a wooden desk and white curtains. A second woman enters from the side holding a white cardboard box containing donuts. (2) Close-up shots of a smartphone screen displaying a web interface titled 'AI 冰箱料理顧問'. A finger types ingredients including eggs and onions into a text field. The interface updates to show a detailed recipe for stir-fried eggs with tomatoes. (3) The woman in the black sweater holds her phone towards the camera, smiling and gesturing with her free hand. The background includes a shelf with books and a plush bear. (4) Screen recording sequence showing technical code (CSS and HTML) being generated within a chat interface. The code includes styles for buttons and containers. (5) Transition to the woman using a browser on her phone to visit 'Realtime HTML Editor'. She pastes the generated code, and the functional cooking advisor website appears instantly. (6) The woman continues to interact with the phone, showing how the AI-generated site provides cooking steps. She finishes by speaking directly to the camera with energetic hand gestures against the minimalist studio background.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Tutorial -> Technical Demonstration -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to teach viewers how to leverage Gemini AI to generate functional web code for a specific utility (a recipe finder for fridge ingredients), demonstrating that programming skills are not required for simple AI-driven tool creation.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: While Gemini and the HTML editor are featured, the content is framed as a creative 'how-to' tech tip rather than a paid advertisement.
